description: PARTIAL SAVE: writes ONLY the 'PlatformBridge' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel; all other v1/v2 fields stay untouched. Platform bridge - what the game takes from the player's idosgames.com account and what it lets players show on their public profile. Profile: Off / Default (unset: the platform name and avatar until the player renames themselves in the game) / Always (every platform login overwrites them). Friends: TitleOnly (unset) / TitleAndPlatform (plus mutual follows on idosgames.com whose both sides play this game) / PlatformOnly (only those; in-game friend requests are refused) - applies to EVERY friends-based system: friends list and leaderboard, gifts, attack targets, friends-only Workshop items, recommendations. Notifications: which in-game notifications (Attack, Raid, FriendAdded, WorkshopSale) also reach the idosgames.com notification bell; empty = none. Guests never get platform data; the economy never crosses the bridge; turning the bridge off deletes nothing.

value.description: Platform bridge: what the game takes from the player's idosgames.com account and what it lets the player show on their public profile. Everything is off by default except the profile. What the PLAYER shares about themselves on the platform (the Played and Workshop tabs of their profile) is not the publisher's decision and is not configured here. Guests (no platform account) never get platform data. The economy never crosses the bridge.

Friends.description: Where 'friends' come from for EVERY game system (friends list, friends leaderboard, gifts, attack targets, friends-only Workshop items, recommendations). TitleOnly (unset) = in-game friendships; TitleAndPlatform = plus mutual follows on idosgames.com whose both sides play this game; PlatformOnly = only those, and in-game friend requests are refused with FRIENDS_FROM_PLATFORM.

Notifications.description: Which in-game notifications are also delivered to the notification bell on idosgames.com for players with a platform account. Unset/empty = none. Allowed: Attack, Raid, FriendAdded, WorkshopSale.

Profile.description: Where the in-game name and avatar of a player with a platform account come from. Off = game only; Default (unset) = the platform ones until the player renames themselves in the game, after which the game choice is kept; Always = every platform login overwrites them.

Recording.description: Lets players record videos of the game on idosgames.com (the Clip and Record buttons, background recording of the last minute, Best moments). Unset = on; false = no recording buttons and no background recording. Recording happens in the player's browser; nothing is uploaded.
